structural_observations: The page defaults to list mode and locally switches to create/edit; the table is rendered only in list mode.
The implementation imports and uses shared Button, Input, Card and Accordion components and ts-form-control instead of the previous ad hoc primary button styling.
Category management is list-only, collapsed by default and requires explicit confirmation before rename.
Deletion requires window.confirm with code and description before deleteParameter is called.
Required fields expose local error messages; Input provides aria-invalid/aria-describedby and category select wires equivalent attributes; validation focuses the first invalid field.
Success feedback is exposed through role=status with aria-live=polite; request failures use role=alert.
Category and code remain disabled in edit mode; active is persisted only through the existing update API, while create preserves the existing API contract.
The table owns deliberate overflow-x-auto with a minimum width; surrounding layouts use responsive grid breakpoints rather than a permanently competing editor column.
focused_test_contract: list initial state, collapsed category accordion and list/editor separation
create with uppercase code, reload/list return and accessible success
edit immutable fields, cancel without persistence and save allowed fields
delete cancellation produces zero deletion calls and confirmation enables deletion
category rename cancellation produces zero persistence and confirmation enables rename
API save failure preserves entered values
